title: Zero-state counter vector
statement: The counter vector of the exponential BFS state whose 17 counters are all zero is the constant function on the 17 indices with value zero.
replaced:
Let $v(st)$ be the 17-entry vector of a state’s registers
$N,Lg,s,s1,X,w,K,Bs,U,V,T,T2,Z,C,ch,c,c1$, in that order, and let the zero state have
all these registers equal to $0$. The constant function on the indices $0,$ taking
value $0$ is equal to the register vector of the zero state.
